title: cypress ↔ art-deco tower morph
notes: Two procedural pose generators sharing 70k particles. Pose A: vertical-biased cypress — 55% skeleton particles along an L-system grammar (13° angles, narrow column), 45% foliage-halo particles distributed in a tapered cylinder for Italian-cypress silhouette. Pose B: art-deco tower — 5 stacked rectangular setbacks with 14→6 vertical ridges per tier, horizontal capping bands at each setback, central spire, 16-chevron sunburst crown. Both poses fit to identical 16-unit height so morph is a clean lerp of corresponding particles. Color palette also lerps: forest greens at organic pose → bronze + cream at deco pose. Sway dampens to zero at deco pose. Auto-cycles every 12s; click flips. Direct response to user feedback ('x09 has hope, find such vertical tree, art-deco architecture transition would be great').
